formācĕus , a, um, adj. forma,
I.made in a form or mould: “parietes, quos appellant formaceos, quoniam in forma circumdatis duabus utrimque tabulis inferciuntur verius quam instruuntur,” Plin. 35, 14, 48, § 169 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
